title: Add Google Search Console site verification meta tag

requirements.text: Insert the provided Google Search Console verification meta tag into the HTML <head> so Google can verify site ownership.
acceptanceCriteria: The file frontend/index.html contains the exact meta tag <meta name="google-site-verification" content="J4tH72RdBxc6a0hSEbceJV6xZn8daPsAgqs7i2HbVWI" /> within the <head> section.
The application builds successfully after the change.
When viewing the page source in the browser, the meta tag is present in the rendered HTML head.

constraints: Frontend files listed in frontend.immutablePaths must not be edited.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Implementing other SEO changes (sitemaps, robots.txt, structured data, analytics).
Adding additional Google Search Console verification methods (DNS verification, file upload).
